text:
ashley: Heads-up — LendWave asked for a flexible overage-smoothing + feature-credit program as part of their LOI. They want a soft cap that converts month-over-month overages into credits usable for add-ons (priority routing, verbose logging) for the first 6 months. Wants pricing language we can put in the LOI.

miguel: Do they want this per-tenant or per-route? I remember they mentioned both in the call.

ashley: Per-tenant. Their example: commit 500M tokens/mo, allow a 20% smoothing window, convert excess to credits at ~1.2x token rate so credits can buy add-on bundles.

ben: Main concerns: revenue deferral and billing complexity. Also potential abuse (customers gaming conversions). We should require expiry and eligibility rules. Suggest expiry = 90d.

sara: Expiry is straightforward in the billing system. Conversion rate matters — product economics team recommends 1.5x to preserve margin. 1.2x may erode unit economics.

ashley: LendWave prefers 1.0x for negotiation simplicity. That’s a big delta. They're also asking for a monthly "feature credit" allotment (e.g., 100 feature credits) which add-ons consume.

miguel: Implementation options: (A) convert overage -> promo credits in billing (full automation), (B) keep overage charged at on-demand but issue ad-hoc credits for add-ons (lighter). A is more customer-friendly but heavier infra work.

ben: Launch criteria we should require: 3 pilot customers, anti-abuse rules, automated billing flows, legal sign-off, and acceptance tests for credits redemption. Rough dev estimate: 6 weeks.

sara: Metrics we'd need in Console: credits issued, credits redeemed, credits expired, ARPU delta, and redemption rate. Also show which add-ons are redeemed the most. Guardrail: credits cannot be applied to SLA or support overage fees.

ashley: Can we commit to a controlled pilot with LendWave on Dedicated by EoQ2? They want privacy + hosted routing. If we can't, offer commit + on-demand surcharge as fallback.

miguel: Scoping from infra/dev side: billing changes (~2w), admin UI for credits (~1w), guardrails & expiry automation (~1w), docs + contract language (~1w). Add QA & legal review => ~5 weeks dev + 1 week QA/legal.

ben: Sounds doable if we prioritize. Action items: @miguel please draft EPIC with story-level estimates and risks. @sara draft billing acceptance criteria and dashboard fields. @ashley prepare LOI language options (1.0x / 1.2x / 1.5x) and ask LendWave about 90-day expiry and use for professional services.

ashley: :thumbsup: I'll confirm whether credits can be applied to PS, and whether they're OK with 90-day expiry.

rev-bot: Note added to CRM: LendWave — requested overage->credits pilot; sales rep: Priya; target pilot start: EoQ2.

ashley: Quick example billing rule sketch (for convo with finance):
```
# on invoice: if overage_tokens > 0:
#   credit_units = floor(overage_tokens * conversion_rate)
#   create_promo_credit(customer, amount=credit_units, expires_in_days=90, eligible_addons=[priority_routing, verbose_logs])
```

miguel: I'll have the EPIC draft by EOD tomorrow. Will include opt-in guardrails (whitelist pilot accounts) and an admin toggle to revoke credits.

ben: Great. We'll aim to surface the pilot as "credits pilot" in Console and restrict to Dedicated / enterprise customers initially.

ashley: Thanks all — will update after I hear from Priya/LendWave on expiry and PS question.
